issue.title: bob gcal login that just works
issue.description: `bob gcal login` connects Google Calendar in one command on any host (Mac with a browser, athena over SSH): it fixes the gog-client reuse failure, owns a sign-in flow that cannot hang, explains every Google screen in plain words, recovers from the usual Cloud Console mistakes in place, and renders a calm, beautiful step transcript.

payload.entry: FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE (before remaining-work tale): Read every note on eg.1-eg.4. eg.1 #1, eg.2 #1, and eg.3 #1 are one proposal: the pre-existing prose-table snapshot assertion, already described on bob-cli-87 #13. Applied sase_new_task, searched CI tasks then all task types, swept all 100 tasks created within one week, and inspected active epics. No distinct task duplicate exists; bob-cli-ed is a separate memory proposal. Declined a new task because intervening commit a844d3e1 already repaired the assertion, and the exact targeted lib test now passes on 7328fab2 (1 passed, 4117 filtered, 13.67s). Recorded that resolution on bob-cli-87. No other PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP entries exist. The screenshot sign-in failure and other login acceptance gaps remain epic work, covered by the forthcoming remaining-work tale, not task beads.

LAND AUDIT at 7328fab2: Reviewed original plan, final DECISIONS, all four children and every note, screenshot on epic note #1, source/tests, and phase commits 2ca76ca0/00c44ab4/18d3f97a/7254e106. The memory_signin_record=no branch was honored: none of those commits edits memory. Client normalization/reuse, captured stdio, guided setup, shared resolver, additive JSON and gkeep spinner reuse are present, but the epic is not ready to close.

Confirmed screenshot root cause with installed real gog v0.44.0 cf42bb7c in a throwaway --home/GOG_HOME using dummy credentials and a blocked local proxy: step 1 uses --force-consent while step 2 omits it, and gog rejects that with manual auth state mismatch before exchange. The browser callback also drops its bound port, independently causing the same mismatch. Matching both flags and full redirect reaches token exchange (then the deliberately blocked proxy). Repeating step 1 without an override reuses state, so the claimed fresh-link retry is not fresh. Reviewed upstream via sase_repo, including validateManualState at the installed commit. No real consent or token exchange was performed.

Other remaining acceptance gaps: strict fake must model the real state tuple/rotation; Downloads q is accepted as yes; stale paste does not reprint the link; reruns omit Sign in/already connected and summary; primary calendar IDs can be falsely warned missing; interactive keyring skips, API-disabled resume hints, opener-spawn fallback and denial spinner handling are incomplete. Shared-account integration stops at calendar listing: snapshot events and absent-event queries still omit --account; logout has not adopted deduplication. The docs phase omitted the specified help strings, SSH/fresh-desktop transcripts, several error/security/environment details, and contains Login's Login. These are bounded remaining contract/integration work in the tale, not new follow-up tasks.
